name: Hedy Lamarr (Sample Entry)
bio:
Hedy was an Austrian-American actress and inventor. With composer George Antheil she co-invented an early version of [frequency-hopping spread spectrum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frequency-hopping_spread_spectrum) communication, a technique that underpins many modern wireless systems.

She held a US patent for the design and was inducted into the **National Inventors Hall of Fame** in 2014.
